details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow phase: clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate or heal. Name it in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation only: README.md, an agents.d fragment, or the docs/ directory.
C. A specific script or prompt under scripts/ or prompts/. Give its path.
D. No specific target; this was filed by mistake or as a test, so close the issue without changes.
Q2: What is wrong with that part today?
Choices:
A. A bug or failure you have seen. Link the failing run, PR or log line. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Too slow or too costly (time, API calls or model tokens). Say which metric.
C. Unclear or noisy output (alerts, comments, logs). Say which message.
D. A missing feature. Describe the behaviour you want.
Q3: What result would let this issue be closed?
Choices:
A. A specific observable behaviour change, such as a test that passes, a run that succeeds or a message that changes. Describe it. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable improvement against a target you name, for example "review runtime under 20 minutes".
C. A documentation update only, with no behaviour change.
